_comment: Project-scoped MCP server. Run "npx @zonoid/cli init" to generate a ready-to-use .mcp.json with the correct install path. Or copy this file to the WORKSPACE ROOT as .mcp.json and replace __INSTALL_DIR__ with your actual install path (e.g. $HOME/.claude/orchestrator). Commit it so every session in the workspace gets the graph tools.
_comment_auth: Optional: set ORCH_TOKEN to the same bearer token the daemon expects (env ORCH_TOKEN or <BASE>/token) so the proxy can call /mcp + write endpoints when auth is enabled. Leave unset when no token is configured (the default).

env._ORCH_TOKEN_hint: set ORCH_TOKEN here only if the daemon has auth enabled
